Manoj Kumar Tiwari( born 18 September 1965) is an Indian judge who served as the acting chief justice of the Uttarakhand High Court, appointed on 11 October 2024 till 25 December 2024.
Career
Justice Manoj Kumar Tiwari has served as a judge in the Uttarakhand High Court. He was appointed as the acting chief justice of the Uttarakhand High Court on 11 October 2024, following the vacancy created by the departure of the previous chief justice and served their till 25 December 2024.
